Folks —

Attached a short legal note and the suggested tracked changes. Key points:
- Deletion: propose two paragraphs: (a) standard customer deletion action results in removal from active systems within 30 days, (b) backups and legal hold exceptions described with maximum 90-day retention for backup recovery windows and subject to lawful hold. This balances operability and the customer's need.
- Subprocessor caching: draft language commits to ephemeral KV caching and prohibits persistent export of cache artifacts to subprocessors; adds an audit right tied to SR/incident triage.

I flagged two items that may require commercial signoff: the 30-day vs 14-day deletion ask, and the audit-right scope for caching. Marissa, if you can table those for procurement tradeoffs, I will prepare the evidence statements per the catalogue entries.

Laura Bennett
Senior Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference

Subject: Consolidated response: DPA redlines + evidence pack ETA

Sarah / Tom —

Thanks for the patience. Quick consolidated update:
- Attached: MSA-orderform-amendments-annotated.docx (tracked changes) and evidence-catalogue-20271203.xlsx (with ops owners and artifact links).
- Deletion: Redwood commits to customer-triggered deletion from active production systems within 30 calendar days. Backups may be retained up to a maximum of 90 days for recovery and legal hold reasons; we will document the process for initiating a legal hold.
- Subprocessor caching: Redwood confirms KV caching is ephemeral; we will not ship persistent cache artifacts to subprocessors and have added a contractual commitment plus an operational control note. We can scope a short audit to be initiated via an SOC-style request (limited to triage events).

Open commercial items for procurement tradeoffs: (1) whether the 30-day deletion is acceptable vs customer request for 14 days; (2) whether the audit right wording needs to be narrowed further. If you want, Marissa can propose two order-form options (standard vs expedited deletion SLA) for procurement to review.

Next steps: Marissa will upload the annotated DPA + evidence pack to the drive link and send a DocuSign packet if BrightLabs confirms which order-form option they prefer. Please confirm by EOD Wednesday 2027-12-08 to keep the Q4 procurement timeline.

Attachments: MSA-orderform-amendments-annotated.docx, evidence-catalogue-20271203.xlsx

Best,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
